claims.assertion: Yazhi describes shadow people as semi-physical, semi-astral beings rather than egregors, with most existence in the astral and some in the physical.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She offers this as her best explanation.

claims.assertion: She says they exploit low visibility and seek resources such as food, electricity, and heat; some may also use human energy.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says resources matter more than creative energy.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says special cameras can detect them, and they are more easily noticed in higher-frequency places where they stand out.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says they mostly avoid such places.

coverage_gaps: their reported ability to speak and interact physically
claims about low-light visibility and individual differences
